# Cover › Stroke

**What belongs here.** Drawn strokes sweep across and fill the frame.

**Examples.** brush stroke, marker swipe, ribbon

**Family test.** Pause at the middle: is the frame mostly or entirely a layer that is neither A nor B?

Each transition here has its own folder named by its id (lowercase, hyphens). See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../../CONTRIBUTING.md).

## Transitions

| Transition | Summary |
|---|---|
| [Brush Stroke](brush-stroke/) | A thick, rough brush paints across the frame in a few passes until it is covered, then the stroke wipes away to show the next scene. |
| [Swoosh Lines](swoosh-lines/) | Waves of rounded diagonal ribbons sweep across, the last wave in the new background colour, then sweep on out to show the new scene. |
